name: DSC evaluation (wmc - wmc) - Seperate tractograms
summary: Measures the overlap between estimated and ground-truth white matter bundles, given as WMC classifications of two separate tractograms, with the Dice similarity coefficient, Jaccard index and sensitivity.
description: Converts both tractograms to .trk using the T1, extracts the bundles listed in tractID_list from each WMC classification, voxelizes them and computes DSC, weighted DSC, Jaccard, sensitivity, TP, FP and FN per bundle. Use it to evaluate a bundle segmentation against a reference segmentation of the same subject made on a different tractogram. All inputs must belong to the same subject.

inputs.description: Tractogram associated with the white matter classification (WMC) structure
Ground truth bundles in form of white matter classification (WMC) structure
Tractogram associated with the white matter classification (WMC) structure
Estimated bundles in form of white matter classification (WMC) structure
ACPC-aligned T1 of the subject, used as reference to convert the tractograms from .tck to .trk.

outputs.description: CSV containing the following scalars: DSC, wDSC, Jaccard, sensitivity, TP, FP, FN

parameters.description: ID list of the bundles of interest, separated by commas

citations.text: Dice LR. Measures of the amount of ecologic association between species. Ecology 26(3):297-302 (1945).
Avesani P, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6:69 (2019).

failure_modes.message: Error: estimated segmentation and ground truth segmentation are the same. DSC will be 1.
failure_modes.cause: The same WMC was selected for both seg_est and seg_true.
failure_modes.fix: Select different estimated and ground-truth segmentations.
